seoTitle: Barcode Generator - Create Custom Barcodes Online
metaDescription: Free online Barcode Generator. Create scannable 1D barcodes (Code 128, UPC, EAN) instantly. Download high-quality images for retail and inventory.
intro: Managing a warehouse or launching a retail product? Our free Barcode Generator creates high-quality, scannable 1D barcodes instantly in standard formats like Code 128 and UPC.
whatIs: The Barcode Generator is a digital graphics utility. It takes alphanumeric data (like a product SKU or serial number) and translates it into a machine-readable pattern of parallel black and white lines.
howToUse: Enter the text, number, or SKU you want to encode into the input box.
Select the barcode format you need (e.g., Code 128 is best for general inventory).
The tool generates the barcode image instantly.
Click 'Download' to save the barcode as an image file.
howItWorks: The tool uses a rendering library to map your text characters to the specific line-width patterns dictated by your chosen barcode standard. It then renders those lines onto an HTML5 Canvas element for easy downloading.
workedExample: You select 'Code 128' and enter 'SKU-5542'. The tool calculates the start characters, the specific bar widths for those letters and numbers, adds a check digit for scanning accuracy, and renders the visual barcode.
resultInterpretation: The generated image can be printed on labels or product packaging. Any standard laser or optical barcode scanner will be able to read the lines and output your original text.
useCases: Inventory Management: Creating tracking labels for boxes in a warehouse.
Retail Sales: Generating UPC-A or EAN-13 barcodes for physical products to be scanned at a point-of-sale (POS) register.
Library Systems: Creating scannable ID tags for books or media assets.
tipsAndLimitations: Code 128 is the most versatile format, as it supports both letters and numbers of variable length.
Retail barcodes (UPC-A) require exactly 11 or 12 numerical digits. The tool will throw an error if you try to use letters in a UPC barcode.

faq.question: What is the difference between Code 128 and UPC?
faq.answer: Code 128 is used for general tracking and supports all letters and numbers. UPC (Universal Product Code) is strictly regulated, numerical-only, and required for selling items in retail stores in North America.

faq.question: Are these barcodes legal for retail?
faq.answer: The barcode image generated is mathematically perfect and scannable. However, to sell a product in a major retail store, you must legally purchase a registered UPC number from GS1. You cannot just invent a number.

disclaimer: Barcodes are generated locally. Users are responsible for ensuring the generated codes do not conflict with GS1-registered retail systems if used commercially.
